# Google ML Kit Digital Ink Recognition

Used for reading handwritten words (ADR-0007).

**This is proprietary software, not covered by NibTeXa's GPL-3.0 licence.** NibTeXa
may be combined and distributed with it under the additional permission in
[NOTICE.md](../../NOTICE.md).

- Component: `com.google.mlkit:digital-ink-recognition` 19.0.0, with
  `com.google.mlkit:common` 18.11.0 and `digital-ink-common` 16.0.0.
- Terms: ML Kit Terms of Service, https://developers.google.com/ml-kit/terms,
  which incorporate the Google APIs Terms of Service,
  https://developers.google.com/terms
- Play services client libraries (`play-services-base`, `-basement`, `-tasks`):
  Android Software Development Kit License,
  https://developer.android.com/studio/terms
- Its Apache-2.0 dependencies are listed in the third-party list:
  - Google datatransport;
  - Firebase components and encoders;
  - WorkManager;
  - OkHttp and Okio.

Privacy: your handwriting is recognized on the device. ML Kit downloads the
language pack only when you ask, and it sends usage metrics to Google (device
and app information, performance, errors, configured languages). See
https://developers.google.com/ml-kit/android-data-disclosure
